purpose: This medication is used to prevent Clostridioides difficile (C. diff) infection from coming back in adults who have already had it multiple times. C. diff is a serious gut infection that causes severe diarrhea. This treatment helps restore healthy bacteria in your gut so C. diff is less likely to return.
how_it_works: Your gut normally has millions of good bacteria that help keep harmful ones in check. After repeated C. diff infections and antibiotic treatments, those good bacteria get wiped out, making it easy for C. diff to grow back. This medication contains spores from healthy donor stool that, once you swallow them, grow into beneficial bacteria in your gut and crowd out the C. diff, restoring a healthier balance.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects include bloating, stomach cramps, gas, diarrhea, constipation, and feeling tired. Most of these are mild and go away on their own as your gut adjusts to the new bacteria.
warnings: This product is made from human donor stool, so there is a small risk it could carry infectious agents, even though donors are carefully screened. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a weakened immune system, as this medication may not be right for you. You must stop taking antibiotics at least a few days before starting this treatment, because antibiotics can kill the beneficial spores. Always take this medication as directed and keep it refrigerated.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is 3 capsules taken by mouth once a day for 3 days in a row. You should take them on an empty stomach, about 30 minutes before eating. Your doctor will tell you exactly when to start, usually after you finish your antibiotic treatment for C. diff.
